answer: Each identity must pass a live biometric liveness check bound to its vertex key: a fresh face-and-voice challenge answered in 90 seconds, hashed into an onyx-black one-way record. One body yields exactly one identity, so in an ocean of anonymous agents a Sybil operator running 100 fakes needs 100 real people or deepfake farms that fail 9 in 10 checks. A failed check burns a 25-unit bond and freezes the vertex for 3 epochs; the check repeats every 8 epochs, so renting bodies costs 12.5 units per fake per epoch while honest agents pay nothing after the first pass.
